name: Robinhood Chain mainnet

sources.stockTokens: https://api.robinhood.com/rhj/assets (deployments[chainId=4663].contractAddress, tokenDecimals) — generated from Robinhood's on-chain asset registry, listed at https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts
sources.feeds: https://reference-data-directory.vercel.app/feeds-robinhood-mainnet.json (the data behind https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/price-feeds/addresses?network=robinhood): proxyAddress, decimals, heartbeat, threshold
sources.multiplier: https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/building-with-stock-tokens (uiMultiplier 18 decimals, 1e18 = 1.0); https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/tokenized-equity-feeds/robinhood (token price = equity price x uiMultiplier)
sources.dexConfirm: Uniswap v3 factory 0x1f7d7550b1b028f7571e69a784071f0205fd2efa getPool(stockToken, USDG, fee) over the 100/500/3000/10000 tiers, deepest pool kept; read on-chain with eth_call (token0/token1, slot0, USDG balanceOf, observationCardinality)

note: Copied from the sources above, not yet read on-chain. Run `bun run --cwd services/oracle source-check --chain 4663 --rpc <RHC_RPC_URL>` against a mainnet RPC before launch (VERIFY T3, C4).

dexConfirm.note: Read on-chain on 2026-10-17 (chain 4663): the deepest Stock-Token / USDG pool per ticker (approx. size then: NVDA ~$3.0M, TSLA ~$475k, AAPL ~$255k, MSFT ~$415k, AMZN ~$470k; USDG side ~$560k / $144k / $187k / $244k / $152k on 2026-10-18), observationCardinality 7200 each, spot within 0.1-0.3% of Chainlink. Liquidity moves: re-check every pool (source-check) right before launch. These pools only CONFIRM the Chainlink price (primary-confirm): a divergence above ORACLE_CONFIRM_BPS alerts, it never moves the signed price. USDG is assumed to be $1.
